tei:div.tei:p: (147)na mo rat+na tra ya ya/ rgyal srid spangs nas dka' ba brgya phrag gis/ bla ma brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa bdun brten/ shes bya thams cad yang dag thugs su chud/ rgyal ba nyis par gyur la gsol ba 'debs/ rgyal ba'i mdun na rgyal sras bzang po skyong*/ kha ba can du dpal ldan smar me mjad/ dga' ldan gnas su nam mkha' tri ma med/ yid bzhin nor bu khyed la gsol ba 'debs/ sgrol mas lung bstan rgyal bu dkon mchog 'bang*/ thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' bdag mchog lha chos bdun jo bo bka' gdams pa'i/ rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas khyed la gsol ba 'debs/ rgyal tshab dbang bskur ra sbreng dpal gyi gnas/ brgyud pa bdun ldan jo bo'i man ngag gis/ zhing 'dir ngur smrig 'jin pas mjes par byas/ gangs can mgon po khyed la gsol ba 'debs/ dad gus ting 'jin spyod pa'i gzhung drug la/ thos bsam spyod pas bshad sgrub zung du 'brel/ bka' gdams gzhung pa zhes grags su te pa/ 'jam dpal gzhon nu khyed la gsol (148)ba 'debs/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i mngon rtogs kun/ bden pa bzhi'i lam gyi rim pa yi/ gdams pa'i nyams myong brgyud 'jin spyan snga ba/ thugs rje chen po khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ man ngag gsang ba thig le bcu drug gis/ ngo mtshar brgyud pa bdun ldan spel mjad pa/ rten 'brel dbang 'byor dge bshes phu chung ba/ gsang ba'i bdag po khyed la gsol ba 'debs/ sku mched gsum las rim par 'phel ba yi/ gzhung gdams man ngag bstan pa dgu bzhi ru/ 'gal med skyes bu gsum gyi nyams len gyi/ bka' gdams brgyud pa'i bshes gnyen dam pa rnams/ gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes byin gyis rlobs/ mi che los 'jad lo zla zhag gis 'jad/ skad cig misdod 'chi ba'i chos nyid la/ rtag 'jin tshe 'di'i 'khri ba skye ba'i tshe/ gsol ba 'debs so rgyal ba yab sras gnyis/ byin gyis rlobs shig dge bshes sku mched gsum/

bka' gdams brgyud pa rnams kyi thugs rjes zungs/ gar 'chi nges med gar 'chi'i rkyen mang nges/ su dang 'grogs kyang 'chi (149)ba'i ngang tshul can/ 'byor rgud mtho dman 'chi las ma 'das kyang*/ 'chi med lha bzhin g.yengs bas 'khrul ba'i tshe/ gsol ba 'debs so 'debs so rgyal ba yab sras gnyis/ byin gyis rlobs shig dge bshes sku mched gsum/ bka' gdams brgyud pa rnams kyi thugs rjes zungs/ 'chi ba'i dus na pha ma phu nu dang*/ grogs dang longs spyod dgra gnyen rjes mi 'brang*/ nges par phan gnod dge sdig gnyis las med/ don med chos min bya ba'i brel ba'i tshe/ gsol ba 'debs so rgyal ba yab sras gnyis/ byin gyis rlobs shig dge bshes sku mchod gsum/ bka' gdams brgyud pa rnams kyi thugs rjes zungs/ skyabs kyi mthar thug bslu med dkon mchog gsum/ yid ches dad pas skyabs su legs brten nas/ rgyu 'bras phra mo'i spang blang ma nor ba/ skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa kun/ rtogs nas tshul bzhin 'jug par byin gyis rlobs/ mang du thos pas log pa'i dri ma sel/ rnam dag tshul khrims gtsang mas gzhi bzung zhing*/ byams dang snying rjes byang (150)chub sems 'byong nas/ lta spyod rnam par dag par byin gyis rlobs/ gnyen grogs longs spyod la'ang ltos med par/ phyi tshis grab shams blo sna ling gis bskyur/ nyams len zab mo'i don dang mi 'bral bar/ rdo rje gsum po mngon du 'gyur bar shog dam chos sgrub la 'dun pa gcig tu dril/ grogs dang phugs stong mtha' gnyis mi ltung par/ byang chub sgrub la tshe mthar phyin pa yi/ gtad pa bzhi po mtha' ru 'khyor bar shog mi chos sgrub pa'i khyu nas ling gis bud/ chos brgyad bral ba'i sprang po'i ngang tshul gyis/ bka' gdams gong ma'i rjes su snyogs pa yi/ bud snyogs thob pa gsum la dbang 'byor shog mdor na geg gi lang bas chus rdzogs zhing*/

lham sna bsgyur bas ban gzhi rdzogs pa yi/ bya bral rgyal po tshe 'di blos thong ba'i/ dben pa'i gnas su sgrub pa mthar phyin shog bdag kyang 'di nas tshe 'phos gyur ma thag dga' ldan yid dga' chos 'jin grong khyer du/ rgyal ba yab sras rnams kyis rjes bzung zhing*/ rdzogs (151)(152)smin sbyang ba rgya mtsho mthar phyin nas/ bstan pa'i bdag po khyed bzhin 'gyur bar shog de ltar jo bo yab sras kyi gsung glegs bam/ rin po che las gsung ba bzhin bkod pa'i dge bas bla ma rin chen 'dis tshe 'di blos thong chags chen 'khri ba chod ri dwags smas ma rgya las grol ba bzhin mi med dben pa'i gnas su rang gzhanya gyi don gnyis 'grub pa byang chub kyi sems rin po ches rlan gyis zhe sdang gi me/ gsod pa'i mthun rkyen du jo bo yab sras kyi rnam thar la mos pa chos smra ba'i btsan pa tshul khrims rgya mtshos bris pa dge'o/// /
